import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FastReader {
        private final InputStream in = System.in;
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int pos, count;

        private int readByte() {
            if (pos >= count) {
                try {
                    count = in.read(buf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    return -1;
                }
                if (count <= 0) return -1;
                pos = 0;
            }
            return buf[pos++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = readByte();
            while (c <= ' ') c = readByte();
            boolean neg = (c == '-');
            if (neg) c = readByte();
            int x = 0;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = readByte();
            }
            return neg ? -x : x;
        }
    }

    static class MCF {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            int cap;
            long cost;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, long cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> g;
        int[] supply;
        long[] potential;
        long minCost, totalCost;

        MCF(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            supply = new int[n];
            potential = new long[n];
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            if (cost < 0) {
                supply[from] -= cap;
                supply[to] += cap;
                minCost += cap * cost;
                totalCost -= cap * cost;
                g.get(to).add(new Edge(from, g.get(from).size(), cap, -cost));
                g.get(from).add(new Edge(to, g.get(to).size() - 1, 0, cost));
            } else {
                totalCost += cap * cost;
                g.get(from).add(new Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap, cost));
                g.get(to).add(new Edge(from, g.get(from).size() - 1, 0, -cost));
            }
        }

        void supply(int node, int vol) {
            supply[node] += vol;
        }

        boolean flow() {
            final long INF = totalCost + 1;
            while (true) {
                long[] dist = new long[n];
                Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
                int[] prevv = new int[n];
                int[] preve = new int[n];
                Arrays.fill(prevv, n);
                Arrays.fill(preve, n);
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
                for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                    if (supply[v] > 0) {
                        dist[v] = 0;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{0, v});
                    }
                }
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] top = pq.poll();
                    long d = top[0];
                    int v = (int) top[1];
                    if (d != dist[v]) continue;
                    potential[v] -= d;
                    if (potential[v] > INF) potential[v] = INF;
                    dist[v] = INF;
                    for (int i = 0; i < g.get(v).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = g.get(v).get(i);
                        if (e.cap == 0) continue;
                        long nd = potential[v] + e.cost - potential[e.to];
                        if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = nd;
                            prevv[e.to] = v;
                            preve[e.to] = i;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{nd, e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
                int sink = n;
                for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                    if (supply[v] < 0 && prevv[v] != n) {
                        sink = v;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (sink == n) break;
                int add = -supply[sink];
                for (int v = sink; v != n && prevv[v] != n; v = prevv[v]) {
                    Edge e = g.get(prevv[v]).get(preve[v]);
                    add = Math.min(add, e.cap);
                }
                for (int v = sink; v != n && prevv[v] != n; v = prevv[v]) {
                    Edge e = g.get(prevv[v]).get(preve[v]);
                    e.cap -= add;
                    g.get(v).get(e.rev).cap += add;
                }
                supply[prevv[sink]] -= add;
                supply[sink] += add;
                minCost += potential[sink] * add;
            }
            for (int s : supply) if (s > 0) return false;
            return true;
        }

        long optimal() {
            return flow() ? minCost : -1;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastReader fr = new FastReader();
        int n = fr.nextInt();
        int m = fr.nextInt();
        int k = fr.nextInt();
        int c = fr.nextInt();
        int d = fr.nextInt();
        final int tlim = 105;
        MCF mcf = new MCF(6100);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = fr.nextInt() - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = fr.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = fr.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.n - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
